methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 high-search water flosser models spanning countertop and cordless segments, including flagship Waterpik lines, Philips Sonicare, and budget-tier brands (Bitvae, Coslus, Nicwell, h2ofloss, BURST, Panasonic). Specs were independently re-verified 2026-06-19 against manufacturer product pages (store.waterpik.com / waterpik.com, usa.philips.com, shop.panasonic.com, h2ofloss.com, coslus.com, nicwellonline.com, burstoralcare.com) plus Amazon official listings; medgrade.org review/device sheets and reputable review sites (dentaly.org, livescience.com, electricteeth.com, dentistryforpatients.com) used as secondary corroboration only. Three corrections were applied during fact-check: Panasonic EW1511 runtime (10 min was fabricated; official page states 60 s/fill), Coslus C20 price (42.99 -> 36.99 official), and Waterpik WP-150 tip count (set null; bundle configs vary 6-7). priceUsd reflects the manufacturer-stated or widely-cited US price/MSRP in USD at time of research; tank_capacity_ml in millilitres, max_pressure_psi in PSI; tips_included is an integer count of nozzle/brush accessories in the box; runtime_min is continuous-use minutes on a full tank or charge where stated; release is the launch year. A NULL was preferred over any guess. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Waterpik Aquarius WP-660
products.priceNote: MSRP $99.99 (frequently on sale ~$59.99) on official Waterpik store
products.provenance: Re-verified on official waterpik.com product page: 22 oz / 651 ml reservoir, 10 pressure settings (10-100 PSI), 7 tips (4 Precision, 1 Orthodontic, 1 Pik Pocket, 1 Plaque Seeker), $99.99 MSRP. ~90 s (1.5 min) runtime per reservoir stated on the page. Release year ~2013 per Amazon ASIN B00HFQQ0VU. Tank corrected 650->651 ml to match official 22 oz figure.

products.name: Waterpik Cordless Advanced 2.0 WP-580
products.provenance: Re-verified: 7 oz (~207 ml) reservoir, 3 pressure settings (45-75 PSI, max 75 confirmed), 4 tips, $99.99 MSRP on official waterpik.com page. ~45 s (0.75 min) floss time per fill. Tank corrected 210->207 ml to match official 7 oz spec. Release ~2022 generation. Corroboration switched from medgrade to the official store page.

products.name: Waterpik Sonic-Fusion 2.0 SF-04
products.provenance: Re-verified on official waterpik.com page: 16 oz / 473 ml reservoir, 10 pressure settings (10-100 PSI), 2 flossing brush heads (full-size + compact), $199.99 MSRP, 60 s (1 min) floss time per fill. Amazon ASIN B08WSTTCMG indicates ~2021 availability; exact date not published. Corroboration switched from medgrade to official store page.

products.name: Waterpik Ultra Plus WP-150
products.priceNote: Widely cited retail price; standalone unit, street price often lower
products.provenance: WP-150 is a real Waterpik Ultra Plus model (countertop, 650 ml / 22 oz reservoir, 10 pressure settings 10-100 PSI, ~90 s runtime) confirmed via Superdrug retail listing and Waterpik combo pages; Waterpik no longer hosts a standalone WP-150 product URL (redirects to combos). tips_included set NULL: bundle configurations vary (6-7 tips depending on SKU) and an exact box count could not be corroborated from a primary source. Release date not published by Waterpik. Source switched off medgrade to a live retail page.

products.name: Philips Sonicare Power Flosser 3000 HX3806
products.provenance: Re-verified: HX3806/21 is the cordless Power Flosser 3000 (250 ml removable reservoir, 2 flossing modes + 3 intensity levels, Quad Stream + Standard nozzles = 2, IPX7, $109.95) per official Philips USA page and Amazon official listing. pressure_settings reflects the 3 intensity levels. Max pressure PSI not published by Philips (null). Runtime per fill not published (null). Release ~2022 per manual date and ASIN.

products.name: BURST Water Flosser
products.provenance: Re-verified on official burstoralcare.com page: $69.99, ships with 1 classic jet tip (ortho/perio tips sold separately). 110 ml tank, 3 modes (Standard, Turbo, Pulse), max 160 PSI (10-100 plus extra 60 PSI), 80-day battery, ~20-30 s (0.5 min) per tank confirmed via Electric Teeth review. Release date not published by BURST. Corroboration switched from medgrade to Electric Teeth review.

products.name: Bitvae C2 Water Flosser
products.priceNote: Widely cited US street price (Amazon ~$26-28; MSRP ~$36)
products.provenance: Specs re-verified against official Bitvae Amazon listing (title states 300 ML, 3 cleaning modes, 6 jet tips) and dentaly.org/Live Science reviews: 300 ml tank, 3 modes, 30-110 PSI (max 110), 6 nozzles (5 jet + 1 tongue scraper), 40-day battery, ~60 s runtime. Price ~$26 (Amazon street price; varies $18-36, MSRP ~$36). NOTE: medgrade device sheet lists 260 ml / 100 PSI, which conflicts with the manufacturer's 300 ml / 110 PSI; primary manufacturer figures retained. Source switched from medgrade (403) to official Amazon listing. Release ~2022.

products.name: Nicwell Water Flosser F5025
products.provenance: Re-verified on official nicwellonline.com product page: $59.99, 4 modes, 30-110 PSI (max 110), 5 tips (3 classic jet + 1 orthodontic + 1 tongue scraper). Tank 200 ml and 21-day battery corroborated by dentistryforpatients review. Runtime per fill not published (null). Release date not found (null).

products.name: h2ofloss HF-9
products.provenance: Re-verified on official h2ofloss.com page: 800 ml tank, 13 replaceable nozzles, $43.90 sale price (regular $83.80), 5 adjustable pressure modes, 1200 pulses/min, pressure range up to 110 PSI. Runtime per fill not stated (null). Release date not published (null).

products.name: Coslus C20 Water Flosser (F5020E)
products.priceNote: Regular price on coslus.com official store
products.provenance: Re-verified on official coslus.com page: 300 ml tank, 3 pressure modes (Soft/Clean/Comfort), 5 tips (2 standard jet, 1 orthodontic, 1 periodontal pocket, 1 tongue scraper), ~60 s runtime, 30-day battery. PRICE CORRECTED 42.99 -> 36.99 (official regular price). Max ~120 PSI and IPX7 per product specs/MedGrade. Release ~2022 per Amazon ASIN B0BJ1H89KV (Sept 2022).

products.name: Panasonic EW1511
products.provenance: Re-verified on official shop.panasonic.com page (model EW1511W): $109.99, 5 water pressure settings, 200 ml (0.2 L) tank, max pressure 647 kPa (~94 PSI), 1,600 ultrasonic pulses/min, 2 interchangeable nozzle heads. RUNTIME CORRECTED 10 min -> 1 min: official page states '60-seconds of water flossing per fill' (the draft's 10-minute figure was fabricated). Release ~2019 per operating instructions. Corroboration switched to official Amazon listing.
